dialogues.jp: 「いないか……」
dialogues.en:
"I thought this would be a nice spot to be emotional all
alone......"
dialogues.text:
"I thought this would be a nice spot to be emotional all
alone......"

dialogues.jp: 少々強めの風を身に受け、呟く。
dialogues.en:
After I escaped from school, I came here right after passing
through Sakura Park. I guess I was wrong about her being
here.
dialogues.text:
After I escaped from school, I came here right after passing
through Sakura Park. I guess I was wrong about her being
here.

dialogues.jp:
島を一望できるこの場所の風景も、今の俺には
何の感慨も与えられない。
dialogues.en:
"Shoot! If I'd known she wasn't here, I wouldn't have
climbed up those long stairs!"
dialogues.text:
"Shoot! If I'd known she wasn't here, I wouldn't have
climbed up those long stairs!"

dialogues.jp:
「ひとりで｛たそがれ／黄昏｝るには、ちょうどいい場所なん
　だけどな……」
dialogues.en:
I looked around to make sure that she wasn't here, and went
back the way I came.
dialogues.text:
I looked around to make sure that she wasn't here, and went
back the way I came.

dialogues.jp:
学園を抜け出して桜公園を見回るがてら、真っ
先にここに来たんのだが、あてが外れてしまっ
たらしい。
dialogues.en:
I passed the slow-walking old women, and peeped inside of
the stores.
dialogues.text:
I passed the slow-walking old women, and peeped inside of
the stores.

dialogues.jp:
「くそっ！　先輩がいないと分かってたら、こ
　んなかったるい階段上らなかったのに！」
dialogues.en:
I looked around the crowded shopping arcade, and checked
each store.
dialogues.text:
I looked around the crowded shopping arcade, and checked
each store.

dialogues.jp:
辺りをざっと見回して先輩がいないことを確認
すると、もと来た道を駆け下りる。
dialogues.en: "Shoot. I feel like I'm not getting anywhere."
dialogues.text: "Shoot. I feel like I'm not getting anywhere."

dialogues.jp:
ちんたら歩くおばさん連中を追い抜きながら、
ざっと店の中を覗いていく。
dialogues.en:
I finished my unproductive search and sighed with
exhaustion.
dialogues.text:
I finished my unproductive search and sighed with
exhaustion.

dialogues.jp:
視界の悪いアーケード街を見渡し、店を一軒
一軒しらみつぶしに。
dialogues.en: This island seems so small yet way too big.
dialogues.text: This island seems so small yet way too big.

dialogues.jp: 「くそっ、さすがに｛らち／埒｝が明かないな」
dialogues.en: (Where else can she be......?)
dialogues.text: (Where else can she be......?)

dialogues.jp:
すれ違いが起きていそうな、非効率な捜索を終
え、疲労感のにじむ溜め息をつく。
dialogues.en: I turned away from the shopping arcade and started running.
dialogues.text: I turned away from the shopping arcade and started running.

dialogues.jp: この島も、狭いようで広い。
dialogues.en: I should go to her house.
dialogues.text: I should go to her house.

dialogues.jp: （あとはどこだ……？）
dialogues.en: Ding dong.
dialogues.text: Ding dong.

dialogues.jp: 商店街に背を向け、走り出す。
dialogues.en: I rang the doorbell and waited for an answer.
dialogues.text: I rang the doorbell and waited for an answer.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の家に行ってみよう。
dialogues.en: (No one's here?)
dialogues.text: (No one's here?)

dialogues.jp: ――ピンポーン
dialogues.en: Ding dong.
dialogues.text: Ding dong.

dialogues.jp: インターホンを押し、反応を待つ。
dialogues.en: I rung it again, but there was no answer.
dialogues.text: I rung it again, but there was no answer.

dialogues.jp: （いないのか？）
dialogues.en: I thought she might be home by now......
dialogues.text: I thought she might be home by now......

dialogues.jp: ――ピンポーン
dialogues.en: "Where did you go, Moe-sempai......"
dialogues.text: "Where did you go, Moe-sempai......"

dialogues.jp: もう一度ボタンを押すが、反応は無い。
dialogues.en: I thought about where else she could be.
dialogues.text: I thought about where else she could be.

dialogues.jp:
もしかしたら、帰っているかも、と思ったんだ
が……。
dialogues.en: It's getting pretty late. It's almost time for sunset.
dialogues.text: It's getting pretty late. It's almost time for sunset.

dialogues.jp: 「どこ行ったんだ萌先輩……」
dialogues.en: (Is there somewhere Moe-sempai might go to......?)
dialogues.text: (Is there somewhere Moe-sempai might go to......?)

dialogues.jp: 他に心当たりを探る。
dialogues.en: Somewhere special for Moe-sempai......
dialogues.text: Somewhere special for Moe-sempai......

dialogues.jp:
もうだいぶ日が傾いていた。もうすぐ夕焼け小
焼けの時間だ。
（どこか、萌先輩が行きそうな所……）
萌先輩にとって、大切な場所……。
dialogues.en: "It's almost time for sunset?"
dialogues.text: "It's almost time for sunset?"

dialogues.en: "I know where she is......"
dialogues.text: "I know where she is......"

dialogues.jp: 「夕焼け小焼け？」
dialogues.en: I decided to go to one place that popped up in my mind.
dialogues.text: I decided to go to one place that popped up in my mind.

dialogues.jp: ◆萌先輩の大切な場所◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
高台、商店街、萌先輩の家……先輩はどこを探
しても見つからなかった。そのうち日は沈み、
夕焼け時になっていた。
dialogues.en: I spoke to myself as I felt a strong wind blowing on me.
dialogues.text: I spoke to myself as I felt a strong wind blowing on me.

dialogues.jp:
俺はそこで、ある場所を思い出した。あそこに
なら――
dialogues.en:
I could see the whole island from this point. However this
amazing view didn't impress me right now.
dialogues.text:
I could see the whole island from this point. However this
amazing view didn't impress me right now.
